MediaPreviewValue {\n    /**\n     * Media previews should be enabled.\n     */\n    On = \"on\",\n    /**\n     * Media previews should only be enabled for rooms with non-public join rules.\n     */\n    Private = \"private\",\n    /**\n     * Media previews should be disabled.\n     */\n    Off = \"off\",\n}\n\nexport const MEDIA_PREVIEW_ACCOUNT_DATA_TYPE = \"io.element.msc4278.media_preview_config\";\nexport interface MediaPreviewConfig extends Record<string, unknown> {\n    /**\n     * Media preview setting for thumbnails of media in rooms.\n     */\n    media_previews?: MediaPreviewValue;\n    /**\n     * Media preview settings for avatars of rooms we have been invited to.\n     */\n    invite_avatars?: MediaPreviewValue.On | MediaPreviewValue.Off;\n}\n","/*\nCopyright 2024 New Vector Ltd.\nCopyright 2015, 2016 OpenMarket Ltd\n\nSPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Element-Commercial\nPlease see LICENSE files in the repository root for full details.\n*/\n\nimport { type RoomMember, type User, type Room, type ResizeMethod } from \"matrix-js-sdk/src/matrix\";\nimport { useIdColorHash } from \"@vector-im/compound-web\";\n\nimport DMRoomMap from \"./utils/DMRoomMap\";\nimport { mediaFromMxc } from \"./customisations/Media\";\nimport { isLocalRoom } from \"./utils/localRoom/isLocalRoom\";\nimport { getFirstGrapheme } from \"./utils/strings\";\nimport ThemeWatcher from \"./settings/watchers/ThemeWatcher\";\n\n/**\n * Hardcoded from the Compound colors.\n * Shade for background as defined in the compound web implementation\n * https://github.com/vector-im/compound-web/blob/main/src/components/Avatar\n */\nconst AVATAR_BG_LIGHT_COLORS = [\"#e0f8d9\", \"#e3f5f8\", \"#faeefb\", \"#f1efff\", \"#ffecf0\", \"#ffefe4\"];\nconst AVATAR_TEXT_LIGHT_COLORS = [\"#005f00\", \"#00548c\", \"#822198\", \"#5d26cd\", \"#9f0850\", \"#9b2200\"];\n\nconst AVATAR_BG_DARK_COLORS = [\"#002600\", \"#001b4e\", \"#37004e\", \"#22006a\", \"#450018\", \"#470000\"];\nconst AVATAR_TEXT_DARK_COLORS = [\"#56c02c\", \"#21bacd\", \"#d991de\", \"#ad9cfe\", \"#fe84a2\", \"#f6913d\"];\n\n// Not to be used for BaseAvatar urls as that has similar default avatar fallback already\nexport function avatarUrlForMember(\n    member: RoomMember | undefined,\n    width: number,\n    height: number,\n    resizeMethod: ResizeMethod,\n): string {\n    let url: string | null | undefined;\n    if (member?.getMxcAvatarUrl()) {\n        url = mediaFromMxc(member.getMxcAvatarUrl()).getThumbnailOfSourceHttp(width, height, resizeMethod);\n    }\n    if (!url) {\n        // member can be null here currently since on invites, the JS SDK\n        // does not have enough info to build a RoomMember object for\n        // the inviter.\n        url = defaultAvatarUrlForString(member ? member.userId : \"\");\n    }\n    return url;\n}\n\n/**\n * Determines if the current theme is dark\n */\nfunction isDarkTheme(): boolean {\n    return new ThemeWatcher().getEffectiveTheme() === \"dark\";\n}\n\n/**\n * Determines the HEX color to use in the avatar pills\n * @param id the user or room ID\n * @returns the text color to use on the avatar\n */\nexport function getAvatarTextColor(id: string): string {\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/rules-of-hooks\n    const index = useIdColorHash(id);\n\n    // Use light colors by default\n    return isDarkTheme() ? AVATAR_TEXT_DARK_COLORS[index - 1] : AVATAR_TEXT_LIGHT_COLORS[index - 1];\n}\n\nexport function avatarUrlForUser(\n    user: Pick<User, \"avatarUrl\">,\n    width: number,\n    height: number,\n    resizeMethod?: ResizeMethod,\n): string | null {\n    if (!user.avatarUrl) return null;\n    return mediaFromMxc(user.avatarUrl).getThumbnailOfSourceHttp(width, height, resizeMethod);\n}\n\nfunction isValidHexColor(color: string): boolean {\n    return (\n        typeof color === \"string\" &&\n        (color.length === 7 || color.length === 9) &&\n        color.startsWith(\"#\") &&\n        !color\n            .slice(1)\n            .split(\"\")\n            .some((c) => isNaN(parseInt(c, 16)))\n    );\n}\n\nfunction urlForColor(color: string): string {\n    const size = 40;\n    const canvas = document.createElement(\"canvas\");\n    canvas.width = size;\n    canvas.height = size;\n    const ctx = canvas.getContext(\"2d\");\n    // bail out when using jsdom in unit tests\n    if (!ctx) {\n        return \"\";\n    }\n    ctx.fillStyle = color;\n    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, size, size);\n    return canvas.toDataURL();\n}\n\n// XXX: Ideally we'd clear this cache when the theme changes\n// but since this function is at global scope, it's a bit\n// hard to install a listener here, even if there were a clear event to listen to\nconst colorToDataURLCache = new Map<string, string>();\n\nexport function defaultAvatarUrlForString(s: string): string {\n    if (!s) return \"\"; // XXX: should never happen but empirically does by evidence of a rageshake\n    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/rules-of-hooks\n    const colorIndex = useIdColorHash(s);\n    // overwritten color value in custom themes\n    const cssVariable = `--avatar-background-colors_${colorIndex}`;\n    const cssValue = getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue(cssVariable);\n    // Light colors are the default\n    const color =\n        cssValue || isDarkTheme() ? AVATAR_BG_DARK_COLORS[colorIndex - 1] : AVATAR_BG_LIGHT_COLORS[colorIndex - 1];\n\n    let dataUrl = colorToDataURLCache.get(color);\n    if (!dataUrl) {\n        // validate color as this can come from account_data\n        // with custom theming\n        if (isValidHexColor(color)) {\n            dataUrl = urlForColor(color);\n            colorToDataURLCache.set(color, dataUrl);\n        } else {\n            dataUrl = \"\";\n        }\n    }\n    return dataUrl;\n}\n\n/**\n * returns the first (non-sigil) character of 'name',\n * converted to uppercase\n * @param {string} name\n * @returns {string} the first letter\n */\nexport function getInitialLetter(name: string): string | undefined {\n    if (!name) {\n        // XXX: We should find out what causes the name to sometimes be falsy.\n        console.trace(\"`name` argument to `getInitialLetter` not supplied\");\n        return undefined;\n    }\n    if (name.length < 1) {\n        return undefined;\n    }\n\n    const initial = name[0];\n    if ((initial === \"@\" || initial === \"#\" || initial === \"+\") && name[1]) {\n        name = name.substring(1);\n    }\n\n    return getFirstGrapheme(name).toUpperCase();\n}\n\nexport function avatarUrlForRoom(\n    room: Room | null,\n    width?: number,\n    height?: number,\n    resizeMethod?: ResizeMethod,\n    avatarMxcOverride?: string,\n): string | null {\n    if (!room) return null; // null-guard\n    const mxc = avatarMxcOverride ?? room.getMxcAvatarUrl();\n    if (mxc) {\n        const media = mediaFromMxc(mxc);\n        if (width !== undefined && height !== undefined) {\n            return media.getThumbnailOfSourceHttp(width, height, resizeMethod);\n        }\n        return media.srcHttp;\n    }\n\n    // space rooms cannot be DMs so skip the rest\n    if (room.isSpaceRoom()) return null;\n\n    // If the room is not a DM don't fallback to a member avatar\n    if (!DMRoomMap.shared().getUserIdForRoomId(room.roomId) && !isLocalRoom(room)) {\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    // If there are only two members in the DM use the avatar of the other member\n    const otherMember = room.getAvatarFallbackMember();\n    if (otherMember?.getMxcAvatarUrl()) {\n        const media = mediaFromMxc(otherMember.getMxcAvatarUrl());\n        if (width !== undefined && height !== undefined) {\n            return media.getThumbnailOfSourceHttp(width, height, resizeMethod);\n        }\n        return media.srcHttp;\n    }\n    return null;\n}\n","/*\nCopyright 2024 New Vector Ltd.\nCopyright 2020-2024 The Matrix.org Foundation C.I.C.\nCopyright 2018 New Vector Ltd\nCopyright 2016 Aviral Dasgupta\nCopyright 2016 OpenMarket Ltd\n\nSPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Element-Commercial\nPlease see LICENSE files in the repository root for full details.\n*/\n\n// Note: we don't import the base64 utils from `matrix-js-sdk/src/matrix` because this file\n// is used by Element Web's service worker, and importing `matrix` brings in ~1mb of stuff\n// we don't need. Instead, we ignore the import restriction and only bring in what we actually\n// need.\n// Note: `base64` is not public in the js-sdk, so if it changes/breaks, that's on us. We should\n// be okay with our frequent tests, locked versioning, etc though. We'll pick up problems well\n// before release.\n// eslint-disable-next-line no-restricted-imports\nimport { encodeUnpaddedBase64 } from \"matrix-js-sdk/src/base64\";\nimport { logger } from \"matrix-js-sdk/src/logger\";\n\n/**\n * Encrypted format of a pickle key, as stored in IndexedDB.\n */\nexport interface EncryptedPickleKey {\n    /** The encrypted payload. */\n    encrypted?: BufferSource;\n\n    /** Initialisation vector for the encryption. */\n    iv?: BufferSource;\n\n    /** The encryption key which was used to encrypt the payload. */\n    cryptoKey?: CryptoKey;\n}\n\n/**\n * Calculates the `additionalData` for the AES-GCM key used by the pickling processes. This\n * additional data is *not* encrypted, but *is* authenticated. The additional data is constructed\n * from the user ID and device ID provided.\n *\n * The later-constructed pickle key is used to decrypt values, such as access tokens, from IndexedDB.\n *\n * See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AesGcmParams for more information on\n * `additionalData`.\n *\n * @param {string} userId The user ID who owns the pickle key.\n * @param {string} deviceId The device ID which owns the pickle key.\n * @returns {Uint8Array} The additional data as a Uint8Array.\n */\nexport function getPickleAdditionalData(userId: string, deviceId: string): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> {\n    const additionalData = new Uint8Array(userId.length + deviceId.length + 1);\n    for (let i = 0; i < userId.length; i++) {\n        additionalData[i] = userId.charCodeAt(i);\n    }\n    additionalData[userId.length] = 124; // \"|\"\n    for (let i = 0; i < deviceId.length; i++) {\n        additionalData[userId.length + 1 + i] = deviceId.charCodeAt(i);\n    }\n    return additionalData;\n}\n\n/**\n * Encrypt the given pickle key, ready for storage in the database.\n *\n * @param pickleKey - The key to be encrypted.\n * @param userId - The user ID the pickle key belongs to.\n * @param deviceId - The device ID the pickle key belongs to.\n *\n * @returns Data object ready for storing in indexeddb.\n */\nexport async function encryptPickleKey(\n    pickleKey: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>,\n    userId: string,\n    deviceId: string,\n): Promise<EncryptedPickleKey | undefined> {\n    if (!crypto?.subtle) {\n        return undefined;\n    }\n    const cryptoKey = await crypto.subtle.generateKey({ name: \"AES-GCM\", length: 256 }, false, [\"encrypt\", \"decrypt\"]);\n    const iv = new Uint8Array(32);\n    crypto.getRandomValues(iv);\n\n    const additionalData = getPickleAdditionalData(userId, deviceId);\n    const encrypted = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: \"AES-GCM\", iv, additionalData }, cryptoKey, pickleKey);\n    return { encrypted, iv, cryptoKey };\n}\n\n/**\n * Decrypts the provided data into a pickle key and base64-encodes it ready for use elsewhere.\n *\n * If `data` is undefined in part or in full, returns undefined.\n *\n *  If crypto functions are not available, returns undefined regardless of input.\n *\n * @param data An object containing the encrypted pickle key data: encrypted payload, initialization vector (IV), and crypto key. Typically loaded from indexedDB.\n * @param userId The user ID the pickle key belongs to.\n * @param deviceId The device ID the pickle key belongs to.\n * @returns A promise that resolves to the encoded pickle key, or undefined if the key cannot be built and encoded.\n */\nexport async function buildAndEncodePickleKey(\n    data: EncryptedPickleKey | undefined,\n    userId: string,\n    deviceId: string,\n): Promise<string | undefined> {\n    if (!crypto?.subtle) {\n        return undefined;\n    }\n    if (!data || !data.encrypted || !data.iv || !data.cryptoKey) {\n        return undefined;\n    }\n\n    try {\n        const additionalData = getPickleAdditionalData(userId, deviceId);\n        const pickleKeyBuf = await crypto.subtle.decrypt(\n            { name: \"AES-GCM\", iv: data.iv, additionalData },\n            data.cryptoKey,\n            data.encrypted,\n        );\n        if (pickleKeyBuf) {\n            return encodeUnpaddedBase64(new Uint8Array(pickleKeyBuf));\n        }\n    } catch {\n        logger.error(\"Error decrypting pickle key\");\n    }\n\n    return undefined;\n}\n","/*\nCopyright 2018-2024 New Vector Ltd.\n\nSPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Element-Commercial\nPlease see LICENSE files in the repository root for full details.\n*/\n\nimport type { IConfigOptions } from \"../IConfigOptions\";\n\n// Load the config file. First try to load up a domain-specific config of the\n// form \"config.$domain.json\" and if that fails, fall back to config.json.\nexport async function getVectorConfig(relativeLocation = \"\"): Promise<IConfigOptions | undefined> {\n    if (relativeLocation !== \"\" && !relativeLocation.endsWith(\"/\")) relativeLocation += \"/\";\n\n    // Handle trailing dot FQDNs\n    let domain = window.location.hostname.trimEnd();\n    if (domain.endsWith(\".\")) {\n        domain = domain.slice(0, -1);\n    }\n\n    const specificConfigPromise = getConfig(`${relativeLocation}config.${domain}.json`);\n    const generalConfigPromise = getConfig(relativeLocation + \"config.json\");\n\n    try {\n        const configJson = await specificConfigPromise;\n        // 404s succeed with an empty json config, so check that there are keys\n        if (!configJson || Object.keys(configJson).length === 0) {\n            throw new Error(); // throw to enter the catch\n        }\n        return configJson;\n    } catch {\n        return generalConfigPromise;\n    }\n}\n\nasync function getConfig(configJsonFilename: string): Promise<IConfigOptions | undefined> {\n    const url = new URL(configJsonFilename, window.location.href);\n    url.searchParams.set(\"cachebuster\", Date.now().toString());\n    const res = await fetch(url, {\n        cache: \"no-cache\",\n        method: \"GET\",\n    });\n\n    if (res.status === 404 || res.status === 0) {\n        // Lack of a config isn't an error, we should just use the undefined : null) as ObjectType<K>;\n    }\n\n    public static put(cfg: DeepReadonly<ConfigOptions>): void {\n        SdkConfig.setInstance(mergeConfig(DEFAULTS, cfg));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Resets the config.\n     */\n    public static reset(): void {\n        SdkConfig.setInstance(mergeConfig(DEFAULTS, {})); // safe to cast - defaults will be applied\n    }\n\n    public static add(cfg: DeepReadonly<ConfigOptions>): void {\n        SdkConfig.put(mergeConfig(SdkConfig.get(), cfg));\n    }\n}\n","/*\nCopyright 2024 New Vector Ltd.\nCopyright 2022 The Matrix.org Foundation C.I.C.\n\nSPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Element-Commercial\nPlease see LICENSE files in the repository root for full details.\n*/\n\n/*\n * Sliding Sync Architecture - MSC https://github.com/matrix-org/matrix-spec-proposals/pull/3575\n *\n * This is a holistic summary of the changes made to Element-Web / React SDK / JS SDK to enable sliding sync.\n * This summary will hopefully signpost where developers need to look if they want to make changes to this code.\n *\n * At the lowest level, the JS SDK contains an HTTP API wrapper function in client.ts. This is used by\n * a SlidingSync class in JS SDK, which contains code to handle list operations (INSERT/DELETE/SYNC/etc)\n * and contains the main request API bodies, but has no code to control updating JS SDK structures: it just\n * exposes an EventEmitter to listen for updates. When MatrixClient.startClient is called, callers need to\n * provide a SlidingSync instance as this contains the main request API params (timeline limit, required state,\n * how many lists, etc).\n *\n * The SlidingSyncSdk INTERNAL class in JS SDK attaches listeners to SlidingSync to update JS SDK Room objects,\n * and it conveniently exposes an identical public API to SyncApi (to allow it to be a drop-in replacement).\n *\n * At the highest level, SlidingSyncManager contains mechanisms to tell UI lists which rooms to show,\n * and contains the core request API params used in Element-Web. It does this by listening for events\n * emitted by the SlidingSync class and by modifying the request API params on the SlidingSync class.\n *\n *    (entry point)                     (updates JS SDK)\n *  SlidingSyncManager                   SlidingSyncSdk\n *       |                                     |\n *       +------------------.------------------+\n *         listens          |          listens\n *                     SlidingSync\n *                     (sync loop,\n *                      list ops)\n */\n\nimport { type MatrixClient, ClientEvent, EventType, type Room } from \"matrix-js-sdk/src/matrix\";\nimport {\n    type MSC3575Filter,\n    type MSC3575List,\n    type MSC3575SlidingSyncResponse,\n    MSC3575_STATE_KEY_LAZY,\n    MSC3575_STATE_KEY_ME,\n    MSC3575_WILDCARD,\n    SlidingSync,\n    SlidingSyncEvent,\n    SlidingSyncState,\n} from \"matrix-js-sdk/src/sliding-sync\";\nimport { logger } from \"matrix-js-sdk/src/logger\";\nimport { sleep } from \"matrix-js-sdk/src/utils\";\n\n// how long to long poll for\nconst SLIDING_SYNC_TIMEOUT_MS = 20 * 1000;\n\n// The state events we will get for every single room/space/old room/etc\n// This list is only augmented when a direct room subscription is made. (e.g you view a room)\nconst REQUIRED_STATE_LIST = [\n    [EventType.RoomJoinRules, \"\"], // the public icon on the room list\n    [EventType.RoomAvatar, \"\"], // any room avatar\n    [EventType.RoomCanonicalAlias, \"\"], // for room name calculations\n    [EventType.RoomTombstone, \"\"], // lets JS SDK hide rooms which are dead\n    [EventType.RoomEncryption, \"\"], // lets rooms be configured for E2EE correctly\n    [EventType.RoomCreate, \"\"], // for isSpaceRoom checks\n    [EventType.SpaceChild, MSC3575_WILDCARD], // all space children\n    [EventType.SpaceParent, MSC3575_WILDCARD], // all space parents\n    [EventType.RoomMember, MSC3575_STATE_KEY_ME], // lets the client calculate that we are in fact in the room\n];\n\n// the things to fetch when a user clicks on a room\nconst DEFAULT_ROOM_SUBSCRIPTION_INFO = {\n    timeline_limit: 50,\n    // missing required_state which will change depending on the kind of room\n    include_old_rooms: {\n        timeline_limit: 0,\n        required_state: REQUIRED_STATE_LIST,\n    },\n};\n// lazy load room members so rooms like Matrix HQ don't take forever to load\nconst UNENCRYPTED_SUBSCRIPTION_NAME = \"unencrypted\";\nconst UNENCRYPTED_SUBSCRIPTION = {\n    required_state: [\n        [EventType.RoomMember, MSC3575_STATE_KEY_ME], // except for m.room.members, get our own membership\n        [EventType.RoomMember, MSC3575_STATE_KEY_LAZY], // ...and lazy load the rest.\n    ],\n    ...DEFAULT_ROOM_SUBSCRIPTION_INFO,\n};\n\n// we need all the room members in encrypted rooms because we need to know which users to encrypt\n// messages for.\nconst ENCRYPTED_SUBSCRIPTION = {\n    required_state: [\n        [MSC3575_WILDCARD, MSC3575_WILDCARD], // all events\n    ],\n    ...DEFAULT_ROOM_SUBSCRIPTION_INFO,\n};\n\n// the complete set of lists made in SSS. The manager will spider all of these lists depending\n// on the count for each one.\nconst sssLists: Record<string, MSC3575List> = {\n    spaces: {\n        ranges: [[0, 10]],\n        timeline_limit: 0, // we don't care about the most recent message for spaces\n        required_state: REQUIRED_STATE_LIST,\n        include_old_rooms: {\n            timeline_limit: 0,\n            required_state: REQUIRED_STATE_LIST,\n        },\n        filters: {\n            room_types: [\"m.space\"],\n        },\n    },\n    invites: {\n        ranges: [[0, 10]],\n        timeline_limit: 1, // most recent message display\n        required_state: REQUIRED_STATE_LIST,\n        include_old_rooms: {\n            timeline_limit: 0,\n            required_state: REQUIRED_STATE_LIST,\n        },\n        filters: {\n            is_invite: true,\n        },\n    },\n    favourites: {\n        ranges: [[0, 10]],\n        timeline_limit: 1, // most recent message display\n        required_state: [\"m.favourite\"],\n        },\n    },\n    dms: {\n        ranges: [[0, 10]],\n        timeline_limit: 1, // most recent message display\n        required_state: REQUIRED_STATE_LIST,\n        include_old_rooms: {\n            timeline_limit: 0,\n            required_state: REQUIRED_STATE_LIST,\n        },\n        filters: {\n            is_dm: true,\n            is_invite: false,\n {\n    filters?: MSC3575Filter;\n    sort?: string[];\n    ranges?: [startIndex: number, endIndex: number][];\n};\n\n/**\n * This class manages the entirety of sliding sync at a high UI/UX level. boolean;\n\n    public static readonly ListSpaces = \"space_list\";\n    public static readonly ListSearch = \"search_list\";\n    private static readonly internalInstance = new SlidingSyncManager();\n\n    public slidingSync?: SlidingSync;\n    private client?: MatrixClient;\n\n    private configureDefer = Promise.withResolvers<void>();\n\n    public static get instance(): // create the set of lists we will use.\n        const lists = new Map();\n        for (const listName in sssLists) {\n            lists.set(listName, sssLists[listName]);\n        }\n        // by default use the encrypted subscription as that gets everything, which is a safer\n        // default than potentially missing member events.\n        this.slidingSync = new SlidingSync(proxyUrl, lists, ENCRYPTED_SUBSCRIPTION, client, SLIDING_SYNC_TIMEOUT_MS);\n        this.slidingSync.addCustomSubscription(UNENCRYPTED_SUBSCRIPTION_NAME, UNENCRYPTED_SUBSCRIPTION);\n        this.configureDefer.resolve();\n        return this.slidingSync;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Ensure that this list is registered.\n     * @param listKey The list key to register\n     * @param updateArgs The fields to update on the list.\n     * @returns The complete list request params\n     */\n    public async ensureListRegistered(listKey: string, updateArgs: PartialSlidingSyncRequest): Promise<MSC3575List> {\n        logger.debug(\"ensureListRegistered:::\", listKey, updateArgs);\n        await this.configureDefer.promise;\n        let list = this.slidingSync!.getListParams(listKey);\n        if (!list) {\n            list = {\n                ranges: [[0, 20]],\n                sort: [\"by_notification_level\", \"by_recency\"],\n                timeline_limit: 1, // most recent message display: though this seems to only be needed for favourites?\n                required_state: [\n                    [EventType.RoomJoinRules, \"\"], // the public icon on the room list\n                    [EventType.RoomAvatar, \"\"], // any room avatar\n                    [EventType.RoomTombstone, \"\"], // lets JS SDK hide rooms which are dead\n [EventType.RoomMember, MSC3575_STATE_KEY_ME], // lets the client calculate that we are in fact in the room\n                ],\n                include_old_rooms: {\n                    timeline_limit: 0,\n                    required_state: [\n                        [EventType.RoomCreate, \"\"],\n                        [EventType.RoomTombstone, \"\"], // lets JS SDK hide rooms which are dead\n                        [EventType.SpaceChild, MSC3575_WILDCARD], // all space children\n                        [EventType.SpaceParent, MSC3575_WILDCARD], // all space parents\n                        [EventType.RoomMember, MSC3575_STATE_KEY_ME], // lets the client calculate that we are in fact in the room\n                    ],\n                },\n                ...updateArgs,\n            };\n        } else {\n            const updatedList = { ...list, ...updateArgs };\n            // cannot use objectHasDiff as we need to do deep diff checking\n            if (JSON.stringify(list) === JSON.stringify(updatedList)) {\n                logger.debug(\"list matches, not sending, update => \", updateArgs);\n                return list;\n            }\n            list = updatedList;\n        }\n\n        try {\n            // if we only have range changes then call a different function so we don't nuke the list from before\n            if (updateArgs.ranges && Object.keys(updateArgs).length === 1) {\n                this.slidingSync!.setListRanges(listKey, updateArgs.ranges);\n            } else {\n                this.slidingSync!.setList(listKey, list);\n            }\n        } catch (err) {\n            logger.debug(\"ensureListRegistered: update failed txn_id=\", err);\n        }\n        return this.slidingSync!.getListParams(listKey)!;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Announces that the user has chosen to view the given room and that room will now\n     * be displayed, so it should have more state loaded.\n     * @param roomId The room to set visible\n     */\n    public async setRoomVisible(roomId: string): Promise<void> {\n        await this.configureDefer.promise;\n        const subscriptions = this.slidingSync!.getRoomSubscriptions();\n        if (subscriptions.has(roomId)) return;\n\n        subscriptions.add(roomId);\n\n        const room = this.client?.getRoom(roomId);\n        // default to safety: request all state if we can't work it out. This can happen if you\n        // refresh the app whilst viewing a room: we call setRoomVisible before we know anything\n        // about the room.\n        let shouldLazyLoad = false;\n        if (room) {\n            // do not lazy load encrypted rooms as we need the entire member list.\n            shouldLazyLoad = !(await this.client?.getCrypto()?.isEncryptionEnabledInRoom(roomId));\n        }\n        logger.log(\"SlidingSync setRoomVisible:\", roomId, \"shouldLazyLoad:\", shouldLazyLoad);\n        if (shouldLazyLoad) {\n            // lazy load this room\n            this.slidingSync!.useCustomSubscription(roomId, UNENCRYPTED_SUBSCRIPTION_NAME);\n        }\n        this.slidingSync!.modifyRoomSubscriptions(subscriptions);\n        if (room) {\n            return; // we have data already for this room, show immediately e.g it's in a list\n        }\n        // wait until we know about this room. This may take a little while.\n        return new Promise((resolve) => {\n            logger.log(`SlidingSync setRoomVisible room ${roomId} not found, waiting for ClientEvent.Room`);\n            const waitForRoom = (r: Room): void => {\n                if (r.roomId === roomId) {\n                    this.client?.off(ClientEvent.Room, waitForRoom);\n                    logger.log(`SlidingSync room ${roomId} found, resolving setRoomVisible`);\n                    resolve();\n                }\n            };\n            this.client?.on(ClientEvent.Room, waitForRoom);\n        });\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Retrieve all rooms on the user's account. then they'd assume they can un-check the boxes to un-agree to a policy,\n    // but that is not a thing the API supports, so probably best to just show\n    // things they've not agreed to yet.\n    const unagreedPoliciesAndServicePairs: ServicePolicyPair[] = [];\n    for (const { service, policies } of policiesAndServicePairs) {\n        const unagreedPolicies: Terms[\"policies\"] = {};\n        for (const [policyName, policy] of Object.entries(policies)) {\n            let policyAgreed = false;\n            for (const lang of Object.keys(policy)) {\n                if (lang === \"version\" || typeof policy[lang] === \"string\") continue;\n                if (agreedUrlSet.has(policy[lang].url)) {\n                    policyAgreed = true;\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            if (!policyAgreed) unagreedPolicies[policyName] = policy;\n        }\n        if (Object.keys(unagreedPolicies).length > 0) {\n            unagreedPoliciesAndServicePairs.push({ service, policies: unagreedPolicies });\n        }\n    }\n\n    // if there's anything left to agree to, prompt the user\n    const numAcceptedBeforeAgreement = agreedUrlSet.size;\n    if (unagreedPoliciesAndServicePairs.length > 0) {\n        const newlyAgreedUrls = await interactionCallback(unagreedPoliciesAndServicePairs, [...agreedUrlSet]);\n        logger.log(\"User has agreed to URLs\", newlyAgreedUrls);\n        // Merge with previously agreed URLs\n        newlyAgreedUrls.forEach((url) => agreedUrlSet.add(url));\n    } else {\n        logger.log(\"User has already agreed to all required policies\");\n    }\n\n    // We only ever add to the set of URLs, so if anything has changed then we'd see a different length\n    if (agreedUrlSet.size !== numAcceptedBeforeAgreement) {\n        const newAcceptedTerms = { accepted: Array.from(agreedUrlSet) };\n        await client.setAccountData(\"m.accepted_terms\", newAcceptedTerms);\n    }\n\n    const agreePromises = policiesAndServicePairs.map((policiesAndService) => {\n        // filter the agreed URL list for ones that are actually for this service\n        // (one URL may be used for multiple services)\n        // Not a particularly efficient loop but probably fine given the numbers involved\n        const urlsForService = Array.from(agreedUrlSet).filter((url) => {\n            for (const policy of Object.values(policiesAndService.policies)) {\n                for (const lang of Object.keys(policy)) {\n                    if (lang === \"version\" || typeof policy[lang] === \"string\") continue;\n                    if (policy[lang].url === url) return true;\n                }\n            }\n            return false;\n        });\n\n        if (urlsForService.length === 0) return Promise.resolve();\n\n        return client.agreeToTerms(\n            policiesAndService.service.serviceType,\n            policiesAndService.service.baseUrl,\n            policiesAndService.service.accessToken,\n            urlsForService,\n        );\n    });\n    await Promise.all(agreePromises);\n}\n\nexport async function dialogTermsInteractionCallback(\n    policiesAndServicePairs: {\n        service: Service;\n        policies: { [policy: string]: Policy };\n    }[],\n    agreedUrls: string[],\n    extraClassNames?: string,\n): Promise<string[]> {\n    logger.log(\"Terms that need agreement\", policiesAndServicePairs);\n\n    const { finished } = Modal.createDialog(\n        TermsDialog,\n        {\n            policiesAndServicePairs,\n            agreedUrls,\n        },\n        classNames(\"mx_TermsDialog\", extraClassNames),\n    );\n\n    const [done, _agreedUrls] = await finished;\n    if (!done || !_agreedUrls) {\n        throw new TermsNotSignedError();\n    }\n    return _agreedUrls;\n}\n","/*\nCopyright 2024 New Vector Ltd.\nCopyright 2022 The Matrix.org Foundation This will be `RS_UNKNOWN` if the\n *         the server does not respond with an expected body format.\n */\nexport default async function sendBugReport(bugReportEndpoint?: string, opts: IOpts = {}): Promise<string> {\n    if (!bugReportEndpoint || bugReportEndpoint === BugReportEndpointURLLocal) {\n        throw new Error(\"No bug report endpoint has been set.\");\n    }\n\n    const progressCallback = opts.progressCallback || ((): void => {});\n    const body = await collectBugReport(opts);\n\n    progressCallback(_t(\"bug_reporting|uploading_logs\"));\n    return submitReport(bugReportEndpoint, body, progressCallback);\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads a bug report into a tarball.\n *\n * @param opts optional dictionary of options\n * @returns Resolves with a Tarball object.\n */\nexport async function loadBugReport(opts: IOpts = {}): Promise<Tar> {\n    const Tar = (await import(\"tar-js\")).default;\n    const progressCallback = opts.progressCallback || ((): void => {});\n    const body = await collectBugReport(opts, false);\n\n    progressCallback(_t(\"bug_reporting|downloading_logs\"));\n    let metadata = \"\";\n    const tape = new Tar();\n    let i = 0;\n    for (const [key, value] of body.entries()) {\n        if (key === \"compressed-log\") {\n            await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {\n                const reader = new FileReader();\n                reader.addEventListener(\"loadend\", (ev) => {\n                    tape.append(`log-${i++}.log`, new TextDecoder().decode(reader.result as ArrayBuffer));\n                    resolve();\n                });\n                reader.readAsArrayBuffer(value as Blob);\n            });\n        } else {\n            metadata += `${key} = ${value as string}\\n`;\n        }\n    }\n    tape.append(\"issue.txt\", metadata);\n    return tape;\n}\n\n/**\n * Downloads the files from a bug report. Otherwise we could\n    // just use window.open.\n    const dl = document.createElement(\"a\");\n    dl.href = `data:application/octet-stream;base64,${btoa(uint8ToString(tape.out))}`;\n    dl.download = \"rageshake.tar\";\n    document.body.appendChild(dl);\n    dl.click();\n    document.body.removeChild(dl);\n}\n\n// Source: https://github.com/beatgammit/tar-js/blob/master/examples/main.js\nfunction uint8ToString(buf: Uint8Array): string {\n    let out = \"\";\n    for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i += 1) {\n        out += String.fromCharCode(buf[i]);\n    }\n    return out;\n}\n\nexport async function submitFeedback(\n    label: string | undefined,\n    comment: string,\n    canContact = false,\n    extraData: Record<string, any> = {},\n): Promise<void> {\n    const bugReportEndpointUrl = SdkConfig.get().bug_report_endpoint_url;\n    if (!bugReportEndpointUrl || bugReportEndpointUrl === BugReportEndpointURLLocal) {\n        throw new Error(\"Bug report URL is not set or local\");\n    }\n    let version: string | undefined;\n    try {\n        version = await PlatformPeg.get()?.getAppVersion();\n    } catch {} // PlatformPeg already logs this.\n\n    const body = new FormData();\n    if (label) body.append(\"label\", label);\n    body.append(\"text\", comment);\n    body.append(\"can_contact\", canContact ? \"yes\" : \"no\");\n\n    body.append(\"app\", \"element-web\");\n    body.append(\"version\", version || \"UNKNOWN\");\n    body.append(\"platform\", PlatformPeg.get()?.getHumanReadableName() ?? \"n/a\");\n    body.append(\"user_id\", MatrixClientPeg.get()?.getUserId() ?? \"n/a\");\n\n    for (const k in extraData) {\n        body.append(k, JSON.stringify(extraData[k]));\n    }\n\n    await submitReport(bugReportEndpointUrl, body, () => {});\n}\n\n/**\n * Submit a rageshake report to the rageshake server.\n *\n * @param endpoint The endpoint to call.\n * @param body The report body.\n * @param progressCallback A callback that will be called when the upload process has begun.\n * @returns The URL to the public report.\n * @throws A RageshakeError when the rageshake server responds with an error. });\n    progressCallback(_t(\"bug_reporting|waiting_for_server\"));\n    const response = await req;\n    if (response.headers.get(\"Content-Type\") !== \"application/json\") {\n        throw new Generalized management class for dealing with watchers on a per-handler (per-level)\n * basis without duplicating code. Instead, we'll just\n        // let it fall through regardless and let the receiver dedupe if they want to.\n\n        if (!this.watchers.has(settingName)) return;\n\n        const roomWatchers = this.watchers.get(settingName)!;\n        const callbacks: CallbackFn[] = [];\n\n        if (inRoomId !== null && roomWatchers.has(inRoomId)) {\n            callbacks.push(...roomWatchers.get(inRoomId)!);\n        }\n\n        if (!inRoomId) {\n            // Fire updates to all the individual room watchers too, as they probably care about the change higher up.\n            callbacks.push(...Array.from(roomWatchers.values()).flat(1));\n        } else if (roomWatchers.has(IRRELEVANT_ROOM)) {\n            callbacks.push(...roomWatchers.get(IRRELEVANT_ROOM)!);\n        }\n\n        for (const callback of callbacks) {\n            callback(inRoomId, atLevel, newValueAtLevel);\n        }\n }\n    return LEVEL_ORDER;\n}\n\nexport type CallbackFn<S extends SettingKey> = (\n    settingName: S,\n    roomId: string | null,\n    atLevel: SettingLevel,\n    newValAtLevel: Settings[S][\"default\"] | null,\n    newVal: Settings[S][\"default\"] | null,\n) => void;\n\ntype HandlerMap = Partial<{\n    [level in SettingLevel]: SettingsHandler;\n}>;\n\n/**\n * Controls and manages application settings by providing varying levels at which the\n * setting value may be specified. The levels are then used to determine what the setting\n * value should be given a set of circumstances. The levels, in priority order, are:\n * - SettingLevel.DEVICE         - Values are determined by the current device\n * - SettingLevel.ROOM_DEVICE    - Values are determined by the current device for a particular room\n * - SettingLevel.ROOM_ACCOUNT   - Values are determined by the current account for a particular room\n * - SettingLevel.ACCOUNT        - Values are determined by the current account\n * - SettingLevel.ROOM           - Values are determined by a particular room (by the room admins)\n * - SettingLevel.CONFIG         - Values are determined by the config.json\n * - SettingLevel.DEFAULT        - Values are determined by the hardcoded defaults\n *\n * Each level has a different method to storing the setting value. Features are\n * special-cased to ensure that their values respect the configuration (for example, a\n * feature may be reported as disabled even though a user has specifically requested it\n * be enabled).\n */\nexport default class SettingsStore {\n    // We support watching settings for changes, and do this by tracking which callbacks have\n    // been given to us. We end up returning the callbackRef to the caller so they can unsubscribe\n    // at a later point.\n    //\n    // We also maintain a list of monitors which are special watchers: they cause dispatches\n    // when the setting changes. We track which rooms we're monitoring though to ensure we\n    // don't duplicate updates on the bus.\n    private static watchers = new Map<string, WatchCallbackFn>();\n    private static monitors = new Map<string, Map<string | null, string>>(); // { settingName => { roomId => callbackRef } }\n\n    // Counter used for generation of watcher IDs\n    private static watcherCount = 1;\n\n    public static reset(): void {\n        for (const handler of Object.values(LEVEL_HANDLERS)) {\n            handler.reset();\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Gets all the feature-style setting names.\n     * @returns {string[]} The names of the feature settings.\n     */\n    public static getFeatureSettingNames(): SettingKey[] {\n        return (Object.keys(SETTINGS) as SettingKey[]).filter((n) => SettingsStore.isFeature(n));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Watches for changes in a particular setting. This is done without any local echo\n     * wrapping and fires whenever a change is detected in a setting's value, at any level.\n     * Watching is intended to be used in scenarios where the app needs to react to changes\n     * made by other devices. It is otherwise expected that callers will be able to use the\n     * Controller system or track their own changes to settings. Callers should retain the\n     * returned reference to later unsubscribe from updates.\n     * @param {string} settingName The setting name to watch\n     * @param {String} roomId The room ID to watch for changes in. May be null for 'all'.\n     * @param {function} callbackFn A function to be called when a setting change is\n     * detected. Five arguments can be expected: the setting name, the room ID (may be null),\n     * the level the change happened at, the new value at the given level, and finally the new\n     * value for the setting regardless of level. The callback is responsible for determining\n     * if the change in value is worthwhile enough to react upon.\n     * @returns {string} A reference to the watcher that was employed.\n     */\n    public static watchSetting<S extends SettingKey>(\n        settingName: S,\n        roomId: string | null,\n        callbackFn: CallbackFn<S>,\n    ): string {\n        const setting = SETTINGS[settingName];\n        if (!setting) throw new Error(`${settingName} is not a setting`);\n\n        const finalSettingName: string = setting.invertedSettingName ?? settingName;\n\n        const watcherId = `${new Date().getTime()}_${SettingsStore.watcherCount++}_${finalSettingName}_${roomId}`;\n\n        const localizedCallback = (\n            changedInRoomId: string | null,\n            atLevel: SettingLevel,\n            newValAtLevel: Settings[S][\"default\"],\n        ): void => {\n            if (!SettingsStore.doesSettingSupportLevel(settingName, atLevel)) {\n                logger.warn(\n                    `Setting handler notified for an update of an invalid setting level: ` +\n                        `${settingName}@${atLevel} - this likely means a weird setting value ` +\n                        `made it into the level's storage.               settingName,\n                            roomId: inRoomId,\n                            level,\n                            newValueAtLevel,\n                            newValue,\n                        });\n                    },\n                ),\n            );\n        };\n\n        const rooms = Array.from(this.monitors.get(settingName)!.keys());\n        const hasRoom =  });\n                this.monitors.get(settingName)!.clear();\n                registerWatcher();\n            } // else a watcher is already registered for the room, so don't bother registering it again\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Gets the translated display name for a given setting\n     * @param {string} settingName The setting to look up.\n     * @param {SettingLevel} atLevel\n     * The level to get the display name for; Defaults to 'default'.\n     * @returns {String} The display name for the setting, or null if not found.\n     */\n    public static getDisplayName(settingName: SettingKey, atLevel = SettingLevel.DEFAULT): string | null {\n        if (!SETTINGS[settingName] || !SETTINGS[settingName].displayName) return null;\n\n        const The room ID is optional if the setting is not to\n     * be applied to any particular room, otherwise it should be supplied.\n     * @param {string} settingName The name of the setting to read the value of.\n     * @param {String} roomId The room ID to read the setting value in, may be null.\n     * @param {boolean} excludeDefault True to disable using the default value.\n     * @returns {*} The value, or null if not found\n     */\n    public static getValue<S extends SettingKey>(\n        settingName: S,\n        roomId: string | null,\n        excludeDefault: true,\n    ): Settings[S][\"default\"] | undefined;\n    public static getValue<S extends SettingKey>(\n        settingName: S,\n        roomId?: string | null,\n        excludeDefault?: false,\n    ): Settings[S][\"default\"];\n    public static getValue<S extends SettingKey>(\n        settingName: S,\n        roomId: string | null = null,\n        excludeDefault = false,\n    ): Settings[S][\"default\"] | undefined {\n        // Verify that the setting is actually a setting\n        if (!SETTINGS[settingName]) {\n            throw new Error(\"Setting '\" + settingName + \"' does not appear to be a setting.\");\n        }\n\n        const setting = SETTINGS[settingName];\n        const levelOrder = getLevelOrder(setting);\n\n        return SettingsStore.getValueAt(levelOrder[0], settingName, roomId, false, excludeDefault);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Gets a setting's value at a particular level, ignoring all levels that are more specific.\n     * @param {SettingLevel|\"config\"|\"default\"} level The\n     * level to look at.\n     * @param {string} settingName The name of the setting to read.\n     * @param {String} roomId The room ID to read the setting value in, may be null.\n     * @param {boolean} explicit If true, this method will not consider other levels, just the one\n     * provided. Defaults to false.\n     * @param {boolean} excludeDefault True to disable using the default value.\n     * @returns {*} The value, or null if not found.\n     */\n    public static getValueAt<S extends SettingKey>(\n        level: SettingLevel,\n        settingName: S,\n        roomId: string | null = null,\n        explicit = false,\n        excludeDefault = false,\n    ): Settings[S][\"default\"] {\n        // Verify that the setting is actually a setting\n        const setting = SETTINGS[settingName];\n        if (!setting) {\n            throw new Error(\"Setting '\" + settingName + \"' does not appear to be a setting.\");\n        }\n\n        const levelOrder = getLevelOrder(setting);\n        if (!levelOrder.includes(SettingLevel.DEFAULT)) levelOrder.push(SettingLevel.DEFAULT); // always include default\n\n        const minIndex = levelOrder.indexOf(level);\n        if (minIndex === -1) throw new Error(`Level \"${level}\" for setting \"${settingName}\" is not prioritized`);\n\n        const handlers = SettingsStore.getHandlers(settingName);\n\n        // Check if we need to invert the setting at all. i < levelOrder.length; i++) {\n            const handler = handlers[levelOrder[i]];\n            if (!handler) continue;\n            if (excludeDefault && levelOrder[i] === \"default\") continue;\n\n            const value = handler.getValue(finalSettingName, roomId);\n            if (value === null || value === undefined) continue;\n            return SettingsStore.getFinalValue(setting, level, roomId, value, levelOrder[i]);\n        }\n\n        return SettingsStore.getFinalValue(setting, level, roomId, null, null);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Gets the default value of a setting.\n     * @param settingName The name of the setting to read the value of.\n     * @returns The default value\n     */\n    public static getDefaultValue<S extends SettingKey>(settingName: S): Settings[S][\"default\"] {\n        // Verify that the setting is actually a setting\n        if (!SETTINGS[settingName]) {\n            throw new Error(\"Setting '\" + settingName + \"' does not appear to be a setting.\");\n        }\n\n        return SETTINGS[settingName].default;\n    }\n\n    private static getFinalValue<S extends SettingKey>(\n        setting: Settings[S],\n        level: SettingLevel,\n        roomId: string | null,\n        calculatedValue: Settings[S][\"default\"],\n        calculatedAtLevel: SettingLevel | null,\n    ): Settings[S][\"default\"] {\n        let resultingValue = calculatedValue;\n\n        if (setting.controller) {\n            const actualValue = setting.controller.getValueOverride(level, roomId, calculatedValue, calculatedAtLevel);\n            if (actualValue !== undefined && actualValue !== null) resultingValue = actualValue;\n        }\n\n        if (setting.invertedSettingName) resultingValue = !resultingValue;\n        return resultingValue;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Sets the value for a setting. The room ID is optional if the setting is not being\n     * set for a particular room, otherwise it should be supplied. The value may be null\n     * to indicate that the level should no longer have an override.\n     * @param settingName The name of the setting to change.\n     * @param roomId The room ID to change the value in, may be null.\n     * @param level The level\n     * to change the value at.\n     * @param value The new value of the setting, may be null.\n     * @returns Resolves when the setting has been changed.\n     */\n    public static async setValue<S extends SettingKey>(\n        settingName: S,\n        roomId: string | null,\n        level: SettingLevel,\n        value: Settings[S][\"default\"] | null,\n    ): Promise<void> {\n        // Verify that the setting is actually a setting\n        const setting = SETTINGS[settingName];\n        if (!setting) {\n            throw new Error(\"Setting '\" + settingName + \"' does not appear to be a setting.\");\n        }\n\n        const handler = SettingsStore.getHandler(settingName, level);\n        if (!handler) {\n            throw new Error(\"Setting \" + settingName + \" does not have a handler for \" + level);\n        }\n\n        let finalSettingName: string = settingName;\n        if (setting.invertedSettingName) {\n            // Note: We can't do this when the `level` is \"default\", however we also\n            // know that the user can't possible change the default value through this\n            // function so we don't bother checking it.\n            //console.warn(`Inverting ${settingName} to be ${setting.invertedSettingName} - legacy setting`);\n            finalSettingName = setting.invertedSettingName;\n            value = !value;\n        }\n\n        if (!handler.canSetValue(finalSettingName, roomId)) {\n            throw new Error(\"User cannot set \" + finalSettingName + \" at \" + level + \" in \" + roomId);\n        }\n\n        if (setting.controller && !(await setting.controller.beforeChange(level, roomId, value))) {\n            return; // controller says no\n        }\n\n        await handler.setValue(finalSettingName, roomId, value);\n\n        setting.controller?.onChange(level, roomId, value);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Determines if the current user is permitted to set the given setting at the given\n     * level for a particular room. In this case we should not let the user change the setting.\n        if (\n            setting?.supportedLevelsAreOrdered &&\n            SettingsStore.settingIsOveriddenAtConfigLevel(settingName, handler.canSetValue(settingName, roomId);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Determines if the setting at the specified level is overidden by one at a config level.\n     * @param settingName The name of the settingIsOveriddenAtConfigLevel(\n        settingName: SettingKey,\n        roomId: string | null,\n        level: SettingLevel,\n    ): boolean {\n        const setting = SETTINGS[settingName];\n        const levelOrders = getLevelOrder(setting);\n        const configIndex = levelOrders.indexOf(SettingLevel.CONFIG);\n        const levelIndex = levelOrders.indexOf(level);\n        if (configIndex === -1 || levelIndex === -1 || configIndex >= levelIndex) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        const configVal = SettingsStore.getValueAt(SettingLevel.CONFIG, settingName, roomId, true, true);\n        return configVal === true || configVal === false;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Determines if the given level is supported on this device.\n     * @param {SettingLevel} level The level\n timeline width, manual height overrides, SIZE_LARGE.h\nconst SIZE_LARGE = { w: 800, h: 600 };\n// For Normal the image gets drawn to never exceed SIZE_NORMAL.w, SIZE_NORMAL.h\n// constraint by: timeline width, manual height overrides\nconst SIZE_NORMAL_LANDSCAPE = { w: 324, h: 324 }; // for w > h\nconst SIZE_NORMAL_PORTRAIT = { w: Math.ceil(324 * (9 / 16)), h: 324 }; // for h > w\n\ntype Dimensions = { w?: number; h?: number };\n\nexport enum ImageSize {\n    Normal = \"normal\",\n    Large = \"large\",\n}\n\n/**\n * @param {ImageSize} size The user's image size preference\n * @param {Dimensions} contentSize The natural dimensions of the content\n * @param {number} maxHeight Overrides the default height limit\n * @returns {Dimensions} The suggested maximum dimensions for the image\n */\nexport function suggestedSize(size: ImageSize, contentSize: Dimensions, maxHeight?: number): Required<Dimensions> {\n    const aspectRatio = contentSize.w! / contentSize.h!;\n    const SIZE_LARGE : portrait ? SIZE_NORMAL_PORTRAIT : SIZE_NORMAL_LANDSCAPE;\n    if (!contentSize.w || !contentSize.h) {\n        return maxSize;\n    }\n\n    const constrainedSize = {\n        w: Math.min(maxSize.w, contentSize.w),\n        h: maxHeight ? Math.min(maxSize.h, contentSize.h, maxHeight) : Math.min(maxSize.h, contentSize.h),\n    };\n\n    if (constrainedSize.h * aspectRatio < constrainedSize.w) {\n        // Height dictates width\n        return { w: Math.floor(constrainedSize.h * aspectRatio), h: constrainedSize.h };\n    } else {\n        // Width dictates height\n        return { w: constrainedSize.w, h: Math.floor(constrainedSize.w / aspectRatio) };\n    }\n}\n","/*\nCopyright 2024 New Vector Ltd.\nCopyright 2021 Šimon Brandner <simon.bra.ag@gmail.com>\nCopyright 2021 Quirin Götz <codeworks@supercable.onl>\n\nSPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Element-Commercial\nPlease see LICENSE files in the repository root for full details.\n*/\n\n/* TODO: This should be later reworked into something more generic */\nexport enum Layout {\n    IRC = \"irc\",\n    Group = \"group\",\n    Bubble = \"bubble\",\n}\n","/*\nCopyright 2024 New Vector Ltd.\nCopyright 2019, 2020 The Matrix.org Foundation C.I.C.\n\nSPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Element-Commercial\nPlease see LICENSE files in the repository root for full details.\n*/\n\nimport { type MatrixClient } from \"matrix-js-sdk/src/matrix\";\n\nimport SettingsHandler from \"./SettingsHandler\";\n\n// Dev note: This whole class exists in the event someone logs out and back in - migrateBaseFontV1toFontSizeDelta(): Promise<void> {\n        const legacyBaseFontSize = SettingsStore.getValue(\"baseFontSize\");\n        // No baseFontV1 found, nothing to migrate\n        if   const legacyBaseFontV2Size = SettingsStore.getValue(\"baseFontSizeV2\");\n        // No baseFontV2 found, nothing to migrate\n        if (!legacyBaseFontV2Size) return;\n\n        console.log(\"Migrating base font size V2 for Compound, current value\", legacyBaseFontV2Size);\n\n        // Compute the difference between the V2 and the fontSizeDelta\n        const delta = .join(\",\");\n\n            if (useBundledEmojiFont) {\n                fontString += \", \" + FontWatcher.BUNDLED_EMOJI_FONT;\n            }\n\n            /**\n             * Overrides the default }\n    };\n}\n","/*\nCopyright 2024 New Vector Ltd.\nCopyright 2019, 2020 The Matrix.org Foundation C.I.C.\nCopyright 2019 Michael Telatynski <7t3chguy@gmail.com>\n\nSPDX-License-Identifier:  public constructor() {\n        super();\n        // we have both here as each may either match or not match, so by having both\n        // we can get the tristate of dark/light/unsupported\n this.preferDark.matches || this.preferLight.matches;\n    }\n}\n","/*\nCopyright 2018-2024 New Vector Ltd.\n\nSPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR MatrixClientPeg.get()?.removeListener(RoomStateEvent.Events, this.onRoomStateEvents);\n    }\n\n    private onRoomStateEvents = (ev: MatrixEvent, { roomId }: RoomState): void => {\n        // XXX: This listens for state events in order to remove the active widget.\n        // Everything else relies on views listening for events and calling setters\n        // on this class which is terrible. First, we \"claim\" a lock by periodically writing to `STORAGE_ITEM_PING`. On shutdown, we clear that item. So,\n * a new instance starting up can check if the lock is free by inspecting `STORAGE_ITEM_PING`. it is purely diagnostic.\n     */\n    STORAGE_ITEM_OWNER: \"react_sdk_session_lock_owner\",\n\n    /**\n     * LocalStorage key for the session ID of the most recent claimant to the lock.\n     *\n     * Each instance writes to this key on startup, so existing instances can detect new ones starting up.\n     */\n    STORAGE_ITEM_CLAIMANT: \"react_sdk_session_lock_claimant\",\n\n    /**\n     * The number of milliseconds after which we consider a lock claim stale\n     */\n    LOCK_EXPIRY_TIME_MS: 15000,\n};\n\n/**\n * See if any instances are currently running\n *\n * @returns true if any instance is currently active\n */\nexport function checkSessionLockFree(): boolean {\n    const prefixedLogger = logger.getChild(`checkSessionLockFree`);\n\n    const lastPingTime = window.localStorage.getItem(SESSION_LOCK_CONSTANTS.STORAGE_ITEM_PING);\n    if (lastPingTime === null) {\n        // no other holder\n        prefixedLogger.info(\"No other session has the lock\");\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    const lockHolder = window.localStorage.getItem(SESSION_LOCK_CONSTANTS.STORAGE_ITEM_OWNER);\n\n    // see if it has expired\n    const timeAgo = Date.now() - parseInt(lastPingTime);\n\n    const remaining = SESSION_LOCK_CONSTANTS.LOCK_EXPIRY_TIME_MS - timeAgo;\n    if (remaining <= 0) {\n        // another session claimed the lock, but it is stale.\n        prefixedLogger.info(`Last ping (from ${lockHolder}) was ${timeAgo}ms ago: lock is free`);\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    prefixedLogger.info(`Last ping (from ${lockHolder}) was ${timeAgo}ms ago: lock is taken`);\n    return false;\n}\n\n/**\n * Ensure that only one instance of the application is running at once.\n *\n * If there are any other running instances, tells them to stop, and waits for them to do so.\n *\n * Once we are the sole instance, sets a background job going to service a lock.
